<subject>Greetings Darren</subject>
<body>
Hi Darren,

This is Kate Millstone reaching out to say hello! How have you been?

I was really saddened to learn about Michael. It’s hard to comprehend how something like that could happen to such a genuinely good person.

Looking forward to your reply!

Best regards,  
Kate  
Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd
